items.title: OpenAI ships a Messages plugin that summarises who you talk to and what about
items.summary:
The ChatGPT desktop app can now read your iMessage history and send messages on your behalf. OpenAI shipped the integration this week for Macs running Apple silicon, and Apple, a company it is reportedly preparing to sue, was not part of the announcement. The plugin reads and searches Messages conversations on the machine, covering iMessage, SMS, […]

items.title: The AI Backlash Is Getting Stupider. But Also Smarter.
items.summary: A beer brand is selling urine-mailing as anti-data-center catharsis and a centrist governor who courted $20 billion from Amazon is now calling developers bullies — yet between Shapiro's criteria-based executive order and OpenAI's voluntary training pause, the anti-AI conversation may finally be producing something to actually negotiate with.

items.title: Ex-Google engineer’s espionage convictions overturned, theft convictions stand
